claims.claim: Sharp AR-M201 All-in-One Digital Copier for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies Sharp and shows a multifunction/copier body, but the AR-M201 model number is not shown as readable in the provided observations.
Photos show a unit with lid open and internal parts visible, but no clear, reportable wear metrics (e.g., heavy damage, missing parts, or meter/usage) are provided.
Witness report explicitly does not show test results for printing/copying/faxing; no functional proof is included.
The seller’s statement is truncated; no specific completion (e.g., ready to print/copy) is verifiable from the witness photos.

risks.risk: Unknown functional status (may not print/copy reliably).
risks.proof: A short video or photo of a successful copy/print test (e.g., copy a page, show output finishing, and show no error codes).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as not proven working (untested/possible faults).

risks.risk: Cartridge/toner condition unknown (could be low or empty, causing poor output).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of toner/cartridge label/level indicator and a test page showing print quality.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as needing toner/consumables or with degraded output.

risks.risk: Model number/series may be different from what the seller claims (affects parts availability and value).
risks.proof: Clear photo of the model/serial plate (rear/side) with readable text, plus the control panel model/label if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as generic Sharp copier without confirmed AR-M201 specifics.

risks.risk: Connectivity and power requirements unknown (USB/Wi‑Fi/Ethernet may not work).
risks.proof: Photo of ports + a clip showing the device connected and responding (e.g., PC detects printer/copy command works).
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as limited to basic local operation or unverified connectivity.

risks.risk: Paper handling issues (tray/rollers may be worn or missing; jams possible).
risks.proof: Video of feeding paper from the tray and completing a multi-page copy without jams.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as possible paper-feed/roller wear.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or missing parts not visible with lid open (covers, sensors, belts, fuser area).
risks.proof: Full exterior photos (all sides) and a test showing no error codes; include close-ups of belts/rollers/fuser area if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst case as cosmetically present but mechanically uncertain.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model/serial number plate (rear/side) with readable text to confirm AR-M201.
A short video showing a successful copy/print test (start to finished output) with no error messages.
Close-up of toner/cartridge and any level indicator, plus a test page showing print quality.
Photos of all ports (USB/Ethernet/Wi‑Fi module if any) and a clip showing the device responding to a copy/print command.
Video of paper feeding and completing a multi-page copy without jams.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Sharp multifunction/copier physically, but the key value drivers—confirmed model number and functional test results—are not shown. Without a working test and readable model/serial, pricing would be too uncertain.
